A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
, in a stand-alone test setting, the stand-alone test is a necessary condition for the rule of decreasing serial costs sharing.

, if the cost function satisfies the stand-alone test, then the decreasing serial cost sharing rule is the only rule satisfying the stand-alone test as well as the properties of coalitional stability and individual rationality.
